title: A Great Opportunity
description:
A long-lost classmate texts out of nowhere. Warm opener.
"How have you been? What are you up to? I've got this great business going —
no capital required, ₩1M a month is realistic. Perfect for someone like you.
If you have time, let's meet?"

Unemployed, account nearly empty. {name} has a pretty good idea what this is.
And yet — '₩1 million a month' keeps catching the eye.

choices.text: Go and at least hear it out.  (desperation / trap + time)
Shut it down immediately.  (dignity + safety / relationship + faint hope)
choices.result_text:
{name} replied 'not interested' and closed the chat.
The classmate sneered about 'kicking opportunity away', and the connection ended there.
Let go of the ₩1M fantasy too. When desperate, clarity matters most.

title: The Seminar Room
description:
Glossy hotel seminar hall. Applause. 'Success story' reels. A speaker draped in luxury.
Even {name}'s pulse picks up with the energy for a second.
Then the classmate slides over and grabs a shoulder.
"All you need is ₩3 million in enrollment fees. Card works? Let's change your life."

choices.text: Come to your senses and walk out.  (escape / awkwardness + relationship)
choices.result_text:
{name} slipped out on a 'bathroom' excuse and walked home from there.
The classmate's calls rained down on the way. Blocked.
₩3 million saved. Self-respect saved. But that night was long and cold.

choices.text: 'Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity' — pull out the card.  (false hope / debt + regret)
choices.result_text:
{name} swiped the card. ₩3 million in debt out of nothing.
Within days, the truth was clear — product won't sell, only the debt remains.
Desperation is the most expensive vulnerability.

title: The Day of Collapse
description:
Subway stairs. Eyes white out — and then {name} goes down.
People murmur. Someone reaches for 119.

Months without real sleep. Meals skipped. Running on nothing.
This was the body's final warning.
The ER means money, time, disruption.

choices.text: Go to the ER.  (treatment + relief / hospital bill + time)
choices.result_text:
{name} was put on an IV at the ER. Overwork and malnutrition.
"A little longer and it would have been serious." The doctor's words landed hard.
The bill hit the account again. But the body — came back a little.
Sometimes stopping is the fastest way forward.

choices.text: Wave everyone off and get back up.  (save money + time / health gamble)
choices.result_text:
{name} said "I'm fine" and forced up, walking along the wall.
Saved the hospital bill and the half-day.
But the body felt heavier from that day on.
Whether the saved ₩200,000 comes back at a higher cost — nobody knows yet.

title: The Card Bill
description:
The MLM product sits in storage. Unsold. Every last piece.
And now — the ₩3 million card bill has arrived. Debt collection calls coming in waves.
The classmate has gone silent. From the start, {name} wasn't a friend — just prey.

That 'once-in-a-lifetime opportunity' came back as a daily debt call.

choices.text: Grind part-time jobs and pay it off.  (clear the debt / health + time)
choices.result_text:
{name} took every dawn and weekend shift available.
Ground through it for months and cleared the debt. Credit survived.
But health suffered and the entire time for building seed money evaporated.
The price of the mistake was paid in the most expensive currency — time.

choices.text: Can't pay. Accept the credit damage.  (short-term relief / future)
choices.result_text:
{name} let the card payment go delinquent. Escaped the part-time hell for now.
But the credit score collapsed. Loans, jeonse deposits — all blocked going forward.
{name} paved the road to Gangnam with its own thorns.

choices.text: Swallow pride and ask Dad for help.  (resolved / family + shame)
choices.result_text:
{name} made the call that wouldn't come easily. Asked Dad.
Dad sent the money without asking anything. Just: 'Are you eating?'
The debt disappeared. But that silence hurt more than the debt.
Dad spent six years paying off his own debts. {name} just added to them.
